s.es: limpia la pantalla de la terminal

o.en: produces instructions suitable for the terminal type. Normally, this option is unnecessary, because the terminal type is inferred from the environment variable TERM. If this option is specified, clear ignores the environment variables LINES and COLUMNS as well.
reports the version of ncurses associated with this program and exits with a successful status.
prevents clear from attempting to clear the scrollback buffer.
